data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'petra', meaning 'rock'. In Christian tradition, it can refer to the Rock of Faith or the Rock of Salvation. The name Petraia carries the meaning “Rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Petraia usually hope their child will grow to embody rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: פטריה
in_hebrew.meaning: פטריה היא שם שפירושו סלע או אבן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פטריה הוא שם נשי שמקורו במילה היוונית 'פטרה' (Petra), שפירושו סלע או אבן. השם פטריה קשור קשר הדוק למילה העברית 'פטרה', שגם היא מתייחסת לסלע או לאבן. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורת הנוצרית ומשמש כזכרון לסלע או לאבן שמהווה בסיס חזק ויציב.

in_greek.name: Πετραία
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Πετραία είναι ένα γυναικείο όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'πέτρα' (petra), που σημαίνει πέτρα ή βράχος. Το όνομα Πετραία έχει συσχετισμό με τη βιβλική λέξη 'Πέτρα' (Petra), που αναφέρεται στο απόσπασμα της Πέτρας, ένα σύμβολο πίστης και δύναμης. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Πετραία χρησιμοποιείται ως υπενθύμιση της πνευματικής πέτρας που αποτελεί τη βάση της πίστης.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Petraia" carries a deep cultural significance as it is rooted in the rich history of the Greek language. The Greek influence extended beyond their territory and shaped various aspects of European, Middle Eastern, and Western Christian cultures. This name thus imparts a sense of strength, fortitude, and stability, much like the classical imagery of the ancient city of Petra in Jordan. The word 'petra' itself is synonymous with the idea of a firm foundation, which can be associated with the religious and spiritual traditions of many faiths.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian religion, the name "Petraia" symbolizes the Rock of Faith or the Rock of Salvation, which originates from the New Testament. Matthew 16:18 records Jesus speaking to his disciple Peter, stating that upon him He would build His Church, and the gates of the netherworld would not prevail against it. This promise bestows a sense of security to believers, likening the Church to a strong and unyielding fortress. As a result, having the name 'Petraia' may inspire feelings of steadfastness and unwavering loyalty in those carrying it, drawing parallels to the resilience of the people of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Petraia may be derived from the Greek word "petra," meaning rock. In Christian symbolism, this name represents a strong and unwavering faith, like a solid rock that stands firm in the face of adversity. It also refers to the belief in the Rock of Ages, Jesus Christ, who provides stability and protection.
